sections.markdown:
# Exchange queue metrics: ingest validation
Run the sections top to bottom after the install. Allow 2 to 3 minutes after the first task run.

- **Section 2**: every `exchange.*` metric key the tenant has received. Compare with the metrics table in `exchange/README.md`.
- **Sections 3 and 4**: data points per metric in the last 15 minutes (about 15 is healthy, `last_success` should be 1). A 0 in a `db_*` column is normal on a non-mailbox server.
- **Sections 5 to 7**: collector health over time, queue depth and service states.

input.value:
metrics from: now() - 1h
| filter startsWith(metric.key, "exchange.")
| summarize count(), by: {metric.key}
| sort metric.key

sections.title: Data points: collector health and queues

input.value:
timeseries {
  success      = max(exchange.collector.success),
  duration     = max(exchange.collector.duration_ms),
  queueCount   = max(exchange.queue.count),
  totalMsgs    = max(exchange.queue.total_messages),
  poison       = max(exchange.queue.named.poison_length),
  submission   = max(exchange.queue.named.submission_length),
  mailboxDeliv = max(exchange.queue.named.active_mailbox_delivery)
}, by: {server}, from: now() - 15m, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd last_success = arrayLast(success),
            success_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(success)),
            duration_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(duration)),
            queueCount_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(queueCount)),
            totalMsgs_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(totalMsgs)),
            poison_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(poison)),
            submission_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(submission)),
            mailboxDeliv_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(mailboxDeliv))
| fields server, last_success, success_pts, duration_pts, queueCount_pts, totalMsgs_pts,
         poison_pts, submission_pts, mailboxDeliv_pts

sections.title: Data points: databases, submission counters, services

input.value:
timeseries {
  copyQueue   = max(exchange.db.copy_queue_length),
  replayQueue = max(exchange.db.replay_queue_length),
  mounted     = max(exchange.db.mounted),
  subOk       = max(exchange.submission.successful_submissions_per_sec),
  subTempFail = max(exchange.submission.temporary_submission_failures_per_sec),
  subFailed   = max(exchange.submission.failed_submissions_per_sec),
  subPending  = max(exchange.submission.messages_queued_for_submission),
  svcRunning  = max(exchange.service.running),
  svcPresent  = max(exchange.service.present)
}, by: {server}, from: now() - 15m, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd copyQueue_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(copyQueue)),
            replayQueue_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(replayQueue)),
            mounted_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(mounted)),
            subOk_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subOk)),
            subTempFail_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subTempFail)),
            subFailed_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subFailed)),
            subPending_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subPending)),
            svcRunning_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(svcRunning)),
            svcPresent_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(svcPresent))
| fields server, copyQueue_pts, replayQueue_pts, mounted_pts, subOk_pts, subTempFail_pts, subFailed_pts, subPending_pts, svcRunning_pts, svcPresent_pts
timeseries success = max(exchange.collector.success), by: {server}, from: now() - 1h, interval: 1m

sections.title: Messages per queue (only non-empty queues with -ExcludeEmpty)

input.value: timeseries messages = max(exchange.queue.messages), by: {server, queue}, from: now() - 1h, interval: 1m

timeseries running = min(exchange.service.running, scalar: true), by: {server, service}, from: now() - 15m
| sort running asc, service asc
